claim: Intent-only object identification is stable across repeated reasoning passes; the real failure rate is 4/65, computed from raw per-pass rows, not assumed.
processing_command: csv.DictReader(vlm_stability.csv) grouped by (scene, instruction) in first-seen row order, correct/incorrect per pass_no read directly, not re-derived
known_limitations: Right-hand strip in the report variant (16/18 keyword-baseline divergence) is a real but SEPARATE dataset (experiments/vlm_grid/vlm_grid_results.md) -- not a per-row breakdown of these 13 cells. No keyword-baseline comparison exists for these exact cells.
Rows are source (first-appearance) order, not sorted -- failure clustering is as-occurred.
